text:
```yaml
name: Flaky Monitor

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Tests"]
    types:
      - completed

jobs:
  flaky-monitor:
    if: github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'failure'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download test artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: ctrf-*
          merge-multiple: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: '1.91.1'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Run flaky monitor
        run: |
          cargo install --git https://github.com/spellshift/flaky-monitor.git --branch main
          flaky-monitor --input-dir . --output-file flaky-report.json

      - name: Upload flaky report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flaky-report
          path: flaky-report.json
          retention-days: 30
```
